question: What happened in Britain after a 1974 report linked the whooping cough vaccine to brain damage?
answer: Uptake fell from about 80% to about 30% by 1978, and the disease came back. Between 1977 and 1979 more than 100,000 cases and 36 deaths were reported. In some districts only 9% of children were vaccinated. Parliament answered with the Vaccine Damage Payments Act of 1979, a no-fault compensation scheme.
move: When a protection is dropped, count what it was quietly holding back.
